decisions.question: Effort for each model of the split?

options.label: Fixed: Sonnet high, Opus asked
options.summary: Code agents always high (per-model entry + the Agent call's effort), plus top-level effortLevel high for cloud agents. The setup asks only the Opus main-session effort. DS5 is reworked to this and folded into DS6.

options.label: Fixed: everything high
options.summary: No question at all. Top-level effortLevel high and both per-model entries high. DS5's question is dropped.

options.label: Keep asking, high preselected
options.summary: DS5 ships as built, but high is offered as the default answer for code agents, and top-level effortLevel high is added for cloud agents.

decisions.question: Where do the role rules live?

options.label: Plugin-owned rule file
options.summary: Install the block as .claude/rules/agents-and-integration.md, replaced on every run like model-delegation.md. Reaches every project, including ones with a hand-written CLAUDE.md. The CLAUDE.md template drops those sections.

options.label: CLAUDE.md template only
options.summary: Put the block in the CLAUDE.md template. Only projects without a CLAUDE.md get it.

options.label: Explore on Sonnet, Plan on Opus
options.summary: The plugin ships an agent named Explore pinned to Sonnet (search is mechanical); Plan stays on Opus (it is design work).

options.label: Explore on Haiku, Plan on Opus
options.summary: Cheapest search; Haiku may miss subtle matches in large repos.

options.label: Leave both on Opus
options.summary: No override; highest quality, highest cost.

options.label: By kind of work
options.summary: Judgment skills (spec-new, the three audits, tech-stack-setup, auth-setup) on Opus at high; mechanical skills (spec-check, project-artifact-check, task-add, task-status-update) on Sonnet at medium; claude-setup on Sonnet at high.

options.label: All inherit the session
options.summary: No per-skill model or effort; every skill runs on whatever the main session uses.

decisions.question: Saved effort when an alias moves?

options.label: Warn at session start
options.summary: A session-start hook checks that the current Opus and Sonnet IDs have an effort entry and tells you to re-run claude-setup if not. Aliases keep following new models.

options.label: Pin full model IDs
options.summary: Settings name exact IDs (claude-opus-5-5) everywhere, so nothing drifts; new models are adopted only when claude-setup is re-run.
